# ai-digest

> Open-source Rust (`ai-digest` single binary) + TypeScript/CSS pipeline that fetches ~155 frontier AI sources, guides an LLM agent to curate daily and weekly Markdown digests, renders single-file warm-editorial HTML, and publishes a hardened, GEO/agent-ready Cloudflare Pages site (public by default, opt-in AES-256-GCM encryption).

## For AI Agents

- [Agent Skill](skills/ai-digest/SKILL.md): Portable skill (`agentskills.io`) for both consuming published `ai-digest` sites (via `llms.txt`, `.md` mirrors, `Accept: text/markdown`, and `/.well-known/search`) and running the fetch -> curate -> render -> publish pipeline.
- [Agent & Operations Guide](docs/ai-guide.md): Complete `site/CONFIG` & environment variable table, CLI subcommand matrix, safe optional X recall, and GEO endpoint reference.
- [Contributor & Agent Guide](AGENTS.md): Repo layout, offline build/test commands, pipeline contract, and security invariants.
- [README (English)](README.md) | [README (简体中文)](README.zh-CN.md)

## Pipeline & Key Modules

- [src/fetch/](src/fetch/): Async Rust recall (`ai-digest fetch`) across ~155 zero-key RSS/Atom/arXiv/HF/GitHub/HN/Reddit sources (`--json` supported) plus helpers (`cand`, `check-cands`, `page`, `weekly-late`, `xparse`).
- [src/ledger.rs](src/ledger.rs): Deduplication ledger subcommand (`ai-digest ledger find|recent|add`).
- [prompts/](prompts/): Self-contained daily, weekly, and papers curation prompts (`en` and `zh-CN`).
- [src/render.rs](src/render.rs) & [web/](web/): Markdown -> single-file editorial HTML renderer (`ai-digest render`, `--json`, `--md-en`, inline LaTeX math) with compile-time embedded TypeScript/CSS assets (`web/dist/`).
- [src/geo.rs](src/geo.rs): Public Level 5/5 GEO & Agent Readiness engine (`robots.txt` Content Signals, `sitemap.xml`, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, Atom feeds, JSON-LD, `.md` mirrors, `/.well-known/agent-skills/`, `search-index.json`, and Pages `_worker.js`).
- [src/crypto.rs](src/crypto.rs) & [src/verify.rs](src/verify.rs): Privacy scanner, build-time SHA-256 CSP header finalizer, opt-in AES-256-GCM+gzip page encryption (`ENCRYPT=1`), and native verifier (`ai-digest verify`, with Node WebCrypto parity in `web/dist/verify_decrypt.mjs`).
- [src/publish.rs](src/publish.rs): Site builder, bilingual `/zh/` & `/en/` publisher, Cloudflare Pages deploy, and offline `--demo` builder (`ai-digest publish`).

## Consuming a Published Site

Any public (`ENCRYPT=0`) site built by `ai-digest` exposes:
- `GET /llms.txt` and `GET /llms-full.txt`
- `GET /.well-known/search?q=<query>`, `HEAD /.well-known/search`, and `QUERY /.well-known/search` (`text/plain` or `{"q":"..."}`)
- `Accept: text/markdown` content negotiation on every page, plus direct `.md` mirrors (e.g. `/zh/daily/latest.md`, `/en/daily/latest.md`)
- `GET /.well-known/agent-skills/index.json`, `GET /sitemap.xml`, and `GET /feed.xml`
